rows.label: tlk41700121_02_msg0001
rows.name:
It's been nearly 50 years since Gula
was placed under Superbian rule.

rows.label: tlk41700121_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Gula used to have its own army. My old
man was one of its leading figures.
Hardly anything remains of it now.

rows.label: tlk41700121_02_msg0003
rows.name:
The Gulan army was disbanded after
our defeat. Now there are only small
self-defense corps for each tribe.

rows.label: tlk41700121_02_msg0004
rows.name:
At a glance, it might seem like we're
being ruled, but you could also say
we're protected from other nations.

rows.label: tlk41700121_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Superbia leaves Gulan culture alone.
As long as it protects that, life in
Gula is comfortable enough.
